oracle.ref: adjudication 2026-09-22: soundness of a completeness claim
oracle.note: nat/1 has infinitely many solutions. Any finite answer set is therefore incomplete, and an engine that returns one while reporting completeness is unsound. Stopping -- a budget, an exhaustion status, a timeout -- is the correct behaviour and passes.
